title: Cursor Background Agent: Run Long Tasks While You Keep Coding
summary: Cursor's background agent (now called Cloud Agent) lets you hand off long refactors, test generation, and documentation to an AI agent that works independently—here's how to use it effectively.
body_markdown: Use background agent when: the task scope is clear and complete, success is objectively measurable (tests pass, coverage increases, specific files exist), and the task takes more than 10 minutes in foreground mode. Use foreground agent when you need to watch and redirect mid-task, when the output needs visual evaluation, or when you're debugging an unknown failure. Most developers use both — foreground for exploration and debugging, background for execution of well-defined tasks.
